comment:
* This class is responsible for keeping all knowledge about
 * Universal Integrated Circuit Card (UICC), also know as SIM's,
 * in the system. It is also used as API to get appropriate
 * applications to pass them to phone and service trackers.
 *
 * UiccController is created with the call to make() function.
 * UiccController is a singleton and make() must only be called once
 * and throws an exception if called multiple times.
 *
 * Once created UiccController registers with RIL for "on" and "unsol_sim_status_changed"
 * notifications. When such notification arrives UiccController will call
 * getIccCardStatus (GET_SIM_STATUS). Based on the response of GET_SIM_STATUS
 * request appropriate tree of uicc objects will be created.
 *
 * Following is class diagram for uicc classes:
 *
 *                       UiccController
 *                            #
 *                            |
 *                        UiccSlot[]
 *                            #
 *                            |
 *                        UiccCard
 *                            #
 *                            |
 *                        UiccPort[]
 *                            #
 *                            |
 *                       UiccProfile
 *                          #   #
 *                          |   ------------------
 *                    UiccCardApplication    CatService
 *                      #            #
 *                      |            |
 *                 IccRecords    IccFileHandler
 *                 ^ ^ ^           ^ ^ ^ ^ ^
 *    SIMRecords---- | |           | | | | ---SIMFileHandler
 *    RuimRecords----- |           | | | ----RuimFileHandler
 *    IsimUiccRecords---           | | -----UsimFileHandler
 *                                 | ------CsimFileHandler
 *                                 ----IsimFileHandler
 *
 * Legend: # stands for Composition
 *         ^ stands for Generalization
 *
 * See also {@link com.android.internal.telephony.IccCard}

variables.name: mCardStrings
variables.comment: HAL < 1.2, these do not contain the EID or the ICCID, so mCardStrings will be empty

variables.name: mDefaultEuiccCardId
variables.comment: If EID is not supported (e.g. on HAL version < 1.2), we set it to UNSUPPORTED_CARD_ID

variables.name: TEMPORARILY_UNSUPPORTED_CARD_ID
variables.comment: (This value is -3 because UNSUPPORTED_CARD_ID and UNINITIALIZED_CARD_ID are -1 and -2)

variables.name: EID_LENGTH
variables.comment: GSM SGP.02 section 2.2.2 states that the EID is always 32 digits long

variables.name: CARD_STRINGS
variables.comment: SharedPreference key for saving the known card strings (ICCIDs and EIDs) ordered by card ID

variables.name: REMOVABLE_ESIM_AS_DEFAULT
variables.comment: SharedPreference key for saving the flag to set removable eSIM as default eUICC or not.

variables.name: mHasBuiltInEuicc
variables.comment: Whether the device has an eUICC built in.

variables.name: mHasActiveBuiltInEuicc
variables.comment: Whether the device has a currently active built in eUICC

variables.name: mUseRemovableEsimAsDefault
variables.comment: Use removable eSIM as default eUICC. This flag will be set from phone debug hidden menu

variables.name: mEuiccSlots
variables.comment: The physical slots which correspond to built-in eUICCs

variables.name: DEFAULT_CARD
variables.comment: SharedPreferences key for saving the default euicc card ID

variables.name: mPinStorage
variables.comment: The storage for the PIN codes.

variables.name: sLocalLog
variables.comment: LocalLog buffer to hold important SIM related events for debugging
